9:48.text: Verily, they had plotted sedition before, and had upset matters for you, until the truth
came and the Decree of Allâh
became manifest though they hated it.

9:49.text: And among them is he who says: "Grant me leave
and put me not into trial." Surely, they have fallen into trial. And verily, Hell is surrounding the disbelievers.

9:50.text: , it grieves them, but if a calamity overtakes you, they say: "We took our precaution beforehand" and they turn away rejoicing.

9:51.text: Say: "Nothing shall ever happen to us except what Allâh has ordained for us.
." And in Allâh let the believers put their trust.

9:52.text: except one of the two best things
; while we await for you either that Allâh will afflict you with a punishment from Himself or at our hands. So wait, we too are waiting with you."

9:54.text: And nothing prevents their contributions from being accepted from them except that they disbelieved in Allâh and in His Messenger
, and that they came not to As-Salât
and that they offer not contributions but unwillingly.
